note: BBVA Perú's summary sheet for its Visa and Mastercard credit cards: the Cero BBVA Visa carries a fixed effective annual rate (TEA, on a 360-day base) of 109.99% in soles on purchases, revolving or in instalments, and charges no membership fee. The rate is effective, so a month charges the rate that, compounded twelve times, makes it.
